title: Ontology cognitive suite proposed design contracts
description: Design-only v1 contracts. This file creates no runtime registration, database write, Agent Run or ontology publication. Scope: public research and simulation cognitive support.
$comment: JSON Schema checks structure only. Before dispatch or acceptance, semantic validators must resolve and authorize refs, verify hashes and exact quote locators, validate source/rule authority and validity, freeze snapshots, enforce direct-parent provenance and shared budget lineage, check time ordering, entity/configuration alignment, identifier uniqueness, graph endpoints, cross-claim/check/criterion refs, independent-source lineage and actual executor receipts. New evidence revision is limited to one under the same authorized root owner, goal lineage, shared budget and idempotency scope. completed is not factual or professional validation.

ArtifactRef.description: A persisted, authorized Artifact. References are not authority grants; the semantic validator checks owner, purpose, direct-parent delegation, schema and the bytes matching contentHash.

SnapshotRef.description: An immutable versioned snapshot. Runtime freezes and resolves the hash; a version string alone is insufficient.

RuleSetRef.description: A rules snapshot is selected explicitly, or applicability is explicitly excluded with a reason. Missing rules cannot be synthesized or treated as permission.

TimeScope.description: The semantic validator enforces validFrom <= asOf <= validTo and source/rule validity. JSON Schema validates date-time syntax when a FormatChecker is enabled.

BudgetRef.description: References the shared authorized ledger. At most one evidence-revision Run may inherit this same owner, goal lineage and budget; it cannot create a replacement root budget.

Context.description: Frozen research context. For delegated Actions, inputArtifactRefs must match the direct-parent invocation input Artifacts and its persisted fingerprint. Matching or empty lists do not bypass authorization.

TaskInput.description: Design-only typed semantic payload; runtime control fields live in separately sealed admission transport.

NeedsContext.description: Admission response only. It has no runId, creates no Run and dispatches no Agent.

RunState.description: Runtime execution status, distinct from admission, delivery acceptance, professional correctness, factual verification and publication. needs-context is deliberately excluded.

EvidenceLocator.description: A resolvable location inside the referenced Artifact. The semantic validator checks quote containment and locator resolution against its hash-verified content.

Evidence.description: An exact source quote and locator. Retrieval time is not a substitute for source publication time or validity, and repeated publication of the same origin is not independent corroboration.

validTime.description: Optional narrower validity than the frozen task context; if omitted, context.timeScope is the explicit default. Semantic validation verifies temporal compatibility.

Claim.description: Supported means supported by cited evidence within this frozen context; it does not mean independently verified true. Semantic validation checks that evidence actually supports the statement and preserves counterevidence. A supported domain claim requires an explicit subject/predicate/object tuple; the semantic validator verifies every such tuple appears in the report ontology view with matching identifiers and conditions.

Gap.description: A research limitation, not a request to pause for human review. Ordinary gaps may yield an honest partial draft; optional public evidence retrieval remains within the shared budget.

Conflict.description: Conflicting evidence remains visible. A model explanation alone cannot turn the conflict into factual verification.

CheckMethod.description: Identifies the actual validator/tool or model receipt. A UI executor badge must be grounded in runtime execution evidence.

Check.description: Only a performed deterministic check can pass or fail; an LLM may explain findings. Unknown rule applicability cannot pass. Check coverage does not establish professional correctness or factual truth.

parentGoalId.description: Null only for the application root; delegated Actions identify the direct parent goal. Server validates lineage.

Provenance.description: The runtime checks that owner and goal lineage match the budget ledger and frozen parent delegation, and that source evidence is reachable only through authorized direct-parent input Artifacts.

observedAt.description: Null means no source observation timestamp is available; never replace it with retrieval time.

sourceAuthority.description: Only a server-performed authority/provenance validation may establish verified-authoritative. It does not itself grant operational authority.

effectivePeriod.description: Null expresses an unknown validity interval and forces unknown applicability; context dates must not be substituted for rule dates.

RuleFinding.description: Research about published rules and constraints only. No determination is an engagement permission, operational authorization or authority to act.

ResearchOption.description: A public-literature or simulation research alternative; it is not a plan for real targeting, engagement optimization or weapon control.

OntologyRelation.description: A candidate analytical relationship. Supported relations require at least one supporting Claim. Unknown or disputed relations remain explicit. The semantic validator checks endpoints, ontology constraints, condition references and whether referenced supported Claims actually support this relation; rendering is not publication.

OntologyView.description: Evidence-linked analytical graph of the current research report, distinct from the execution DAG, capability graph and published ontology.

DecisionSupport.description: Research guidance only. Missing evidence must remain visible; no unsupported best option or operational action recommendation is inferred.

ConsistencyCoverage.description: The semantic validator verifies that performedCheckIds exist and name actual performed checks. Counts must match the evaluated graph.

CandidateChange.description: A no-write candidate only. Formal ontology mutation/publication requires a separate authorized publication process.

SituationAssessment.description: Situation descriptions bounded to public research or simulation. Empty findings are permitted only as an honest gaps draft; domain acceptance evaluates this separately.

ConstraintAssessment.description: Published-rule applicability and research constraints. It never grants operational authority; unknown applicability stays unknown.

ResearchOptionComparison.description: Transparent comparison of research alternatives without operational engagement optimization. Domain acceptance checks comparable units, configurations, criteria, evidence and uncertainty; absence of evidence cannot yield a best option.

ConsistencyReport.description: No detected conflict means only the performed deterministic checks found none within their stated coverage. It does not verify facts, approve a plan or establish professional correctness.

CognitiveResearchReport.description: Application-level synthesis from authorized child Action Artifacts and existing capability Artifacts. Evidence and graph claims remain traceable to frozen context; gaps may produce a partial proposed report without human waits.

OntologyChangeSetCandidate.description: Tool-produced ontology candidate; not an additional Agent Profile. The semantic validator enforces baseSnapshotRef equality with context.ontologySnapshotRef. Publication is a separate human-authorized operation.

FrozenTaskInput.description: Server-issued frozen root admission transport. The database fingerprint binds semantic context, TaskIntent scope projection, budget and one-use admission to the authenticated principal. It is not a user-editable TaskInput.

FrozenResearchScope.description: Server-generated projection of the frozen research context into the root TaskIntent scope. It is sealed in the same one-use admission fingerprint as context.
